knowledge:
- key_parameters: data=An AffyBatch instance or a matrix of pre-computed QC features ;; alpha=Significance level for outlier detection (e.g., 0.01, 0.05) ;; qcOut=Optional pre-computed simpleaffy QC object to avoid recomputation ;; plmOut=Optional pre-computed PLM fit from affyPLM to avoid recomputation ;; degOut=Optional pre-computed RNA degradation object from affy to avoid recomputation
- alternatives: ArrayQualityMetrics=A comprehensive package for general microarray quality assessment and visualization ;; mdqc=A package employing robust Mahalanobis distance (e.g., MVE robust covariance estimation) to identify outlying arrays, which can sometimes suffer from masking compared to arrayMvout
- when_to_use: Use when conducting quality control on a large batch of Affymetrix microarrays (such as in clinical trials) to systematically and formally identify outlying arrays for potential exclusion.
- pitfalls: Computing QA diagnostics (like PLM fits and RNA degradation) directly from raw AffyBatch objects within ArrayOutliers can be computationally slow ;; mdqc may suffer from masking, failing to detect all true outliers in contaminated datasets where arrayMvout succeeds.

workflows.name: outlier_detection_from_qc_matrix
workflows.intent: Detect outlying microarrays using a pre-computed matrix of quality control metrics.
input: qc_matrix.csv (matrix of QC features where rows are arrays and columns are metrics)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the pre-computed QC feature data ;; 2. Run outlier detection using ArrayOutliers ;; 3. Plot the outlier detection results.
workflows.code:
library(arrayMvout)
data(maqcQA)
mm = ArrayOutliers(maqcQA[, 3:11], alpha=.01)
mm
data(itnQA)
ii = ArrayOutliers(itnQA, alpha=.01)
ii
plot(ii, choices=c(1,3))

workflows.name: outlier_detection_from_affybatch
workflows.intent: Perform comprehensive outlier detection directly on a raw AffyBatch object by computing and utilizing intermediate QA diagnostics.
input: raw_arrays.CEL (directory of raw Affymetrix CEL files loaded into an AffyBatch object)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the AffyBatch object ;; 2. Compute RNA degradation using AffyRNAdeg ;; 3. Compute simpleaffy QC using qc ;; 4. Fit probe-level models using fitPLM ;; 5. Run outlier detection using ArrayOutliers with the pre-computed QA objects.
workflows.code:
library(arrayMvout)
library(MAQCsubset)
if (!exists("afxsub")) data(afxsub)
sn = sampleNames(afxsub)
if (nchar(sn)[1] > 6) {
  sn = substr(sn, 3, 8)
  sampleNames(afxsub) = sn
}
library(arrayMvout)
data(afxsubDEG)
plotAffyRNAdeg(afxsubDEG, 
  col=rep(c("green", "blue", "orange"),c(8,8,8)))
data(afxsubQC)
plot(afxsubQC)
library(affyPLM)
splm = fitPLM(afxsub)
AO = ArrayOutliers(afxsub, alpha=0.05, qcOut=afxsubQC, 
  plmOut=splm, degOut=afxsubDEG)
nrow(AO[["outl"]])
AO[[3]][1:2, ]

workflows.name: direct_affybatch_outlier_detection
workflows.intent: Detect outliers directly from an AffyBatch object without manually pre-computing intermediate QA objects.
input: raw_arrays.CEL (directory of raw Affymetrix CEL files loaded into an AffyBatch object)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the AffyBatch object ;; 2. Run outlier detection using ArrayOutliers directly on the AffyBatch object.
workflows.code:
require(mvoutData)
data(s12c)
aos12c = ArrayOutliers(s12c, alpha=0.05)
aos12c[[1]]
aos12c[[4]]
